comm-a.desc: A man in his mid-fifties from Lambourn in Berkshire, with an educated southern English accent. His voice is clear and medium-low, crisp at the consonants, and carries well over distance.

comm-b.desc: A man in his early sixties from Malton in North Yorkshire, with a light Yorkshire accent. His baritone is warm and full, with a slight grain at the edges.

comm-c.desc: A man in his late sixties from Newmarket in Suffolk, with a refined older English accent. His voice is light and dry, slightly reedy, and very precise.

comm-d.desc: A man in his early forties from Liverpool, with a softened Merseyside accent. His tenor is bright, quick and forward.

comm-e.desc: A man in his late forties from Ayr on the west coast of Scotland, with a clear Ayrshire accent. His voice is mid-range, firm and evenly paced, with rounded vowels.
